about_pullquote: I built this business on turning up fast and fixing it properly first time.
about_para_1: NC Gas Services was founded over 15 years ago when I got fed up watching householders being let down by unreliable engineers. I wanted to offer something different — a straightforward, dependable service where you know exactly what you're paying and when someone will arrive. We're Gas Safe registered, fully insured, and we keep parts on the van to fix most problems the same day.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on fast response times and honest pricing. We don't pressure customers into unnecessary upgrades, and we stand behind every job with a full warranty. That's why so many St Albans households and landlords trust us to look after their heating and plumbing — and why they call us back year after year.
reviews_heading: What St Albans Homeowners Say About NC Gas Services

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a frozen boiler just before Christmas. Called NC Gas and they came out same evening. Fixed it in under an hour and didn't overcharge. Absolute lifesaver. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler and wasn't sure what to go for. The engineer took time to explain the options, didn't push the most expensive one, and the installation was clean and professional. Really impressed. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Helen R.

reviews.text: Emergency call out at midnight for a leaking radiator. They picked up straightaway, got here in 40 minutes, and sorted it properly. No fuss, no drama. This is the kind of service you want from a gas engineer.
reviews.author: David C.
